retrievalProfile.description: A centered, interlocking custom-lettered logo featuring airbrushed sunset gradients and a palm tree silhouette against a dark navy background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central graphic composition where thick, rounded, interlocking letters are filled with horizontal airbrushed gradients of green, yellow, and orange, integrated with a stylized palm tree and a circular sun motif on a deep matte navy field.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking letterforms creating a unified central mass
Horizontal color gradients transitioning from cool to warm within the type
Palm tree silhouette overlapping the circular sun element
High contrast between the dark background and the vibrant, outlined foreground elements
coreInvariants: Double-stroke white and red outlines around the main lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary logo is centered, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular orange sun element on the right side of the central logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top banner text, drop to the large central logo, and follow the interlocking curves to the palm tree on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive dark navy space surrounding the central graphic to emphasize the vibrant colors.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central graphic against a low-value, low-saturation background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, geometric lowercase script with extended ascenders
letterConstructionRules: Letters must interlock or overlap with shared strokes
Thick, uniform stroke weight with rounded terminals
Multi-layered outlines (inner white, outer dark red)
Integrated illustrative elements like palm trees emerging from strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'l' and 'b' feature extremely tall, parallel ascenders
The 'e' is stylized as a circular form with a horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, colorful, interlocking custom script paired with a minimalist, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for metadata.

preserve: Interlocking nature of the main text
Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar rounded geometric skeletons for the base of the custom lettering.
Matches the wide-tracked, clean geometric sans-serif used for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep navy blue background. In the center, place a large circular orange sun with a dark palm tree silhouette overlapping its right side. Add a thin horizontal orange line at the very top edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom interlocking rounded lettering in the center. Apply a horizontal airbrush gradient (green to yellow to orange) to the fill. Add a thin white inner outline and a dark red outer outline. Place wide-tracked white geometric sans-serif text in the upper third.

verificationChecks: Check that the main lettering interlocks without gaps.
Ensure the gradient transitions horizontally, not vertically.
Verify the secondary text has extreme letter spacing.
Confirm the background is a consistent dark navy.

postGenerationChecks: Is the palm tree integrated into the logo structure?
Are the outlines consistent across all letters?
Is the top text perfectly centered and wide-tracked?
Does the gradient feel like 1970s airbrush art?
recipe.reuseFormula: Interlocking rounded script + airbrushed sunset gradient + palm tree silhouette + navy background = 70s West Coast aesthetic.
